questions.question: A part can be rejected when:
answers: A dimension is made out of tolerance
The part does not follow the process flow
The wrong revision of the print is used to make the part

questions.question: Which of the following provides the highest level of repeatability when turning a shoulder?
answers: Screw feed stop on the cross side
Compound rest set perpendicular to the centerline axis of the lathe
Compound rest set parallel to the centerline axis of the lathe
Indicol stop set on the tailstock

questions.question: The compound rest can be rotated:
A turned part shows a tapered diameter when machined between centers. The most likely corrective action is to:
answers: Adjust the tailstock toward the operator
Adjust the tailstock away from the operator

questions.question: A caliper reads 1.5005 inches. The print calls out 1.500 ±0.001 inches. This part is:
answers: Out of tolerance on the high side
Out of tolerance on the low side

questions.question: In CNC programming, what does M01 signify regarding program execution?
Before running a new program, the safest first program-level check is to:
answers: Skip the tool change and run air cuts only
Verify tool lengths, work offsets, and stock location
Increase the feed rate to maximum to save time
Disable coolant and watch for smoke

questions.question: A machinist measures a finished feature and it is slightly undersized. The first action should be to:
answers: Edit the program offset without measuring again
Check tool wear, offset values, and measurement method before adjusting
Increase spindle speed for the next part
Ignore it if the part still fits by hand

questions.question: A finished part moved during machining and shows a shift in features. The most likely root cause is:
answers: The tool nose radius was too small
Workholding moved or clamps were insufficient
The control language was set to metric

questions.question: When approaching a machine to inspect a freshly machined part, the safest first step is to:
answers: Reach into the work area quickly
Confirm the spindle has stopped and the control is in a safe state
Leave the door closed and assume the program paused

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of referencing the Machinery's Handbook during setup?
answers: To verify thread percentages, tap drill sizes, and allowable limits
To read the operator's personal notes

questions.question: A dimension calls out 1.500 +/- 0.003 in. Which instrument is the better choice for checking it?
Which organization sets federal workplace safety requirements for machine shops?
Before using a hand tool such as a file, what basic maintenance check should be done?
answers: Verify handle is tight and clean

questions.question: Coolant that has become rancid or bacteria-infested is primarily an issue of:
A tapped hole is consistently loose after assembly. The best first process adjustment is to:
answers: Increase tap drill size for more thread engagement
Decrease tap drill size for more thread engagement
Switch to a smaller tap without checking the drill

questions.question: In basic SPC, what does an X-bar chart primarily track?
answers: Average values of sample sets over time

questions.question: Which inspection setup is generally the most repeatable for checking flatness on a surface plate?
Convert 0.625 inches to a common fraction.
Which property describes how much a material resists localized indentation?
A 0.001-inch variation across a surface is best detected with:
answers: A dial indicator on a surface plate

questions.question: An inspection sheet is intended to:
answers: Standardize checks and keep inspection consistent

questions.question: A thin workpiece is lifting at the far end of the vise. The better remedy is to:
answers: Use a low profile stop or strap clamp to support the part

questions.question: After setting the vise, the next repeatability check should be:
answers: Verify the jaw faces are clean and the part is seated on parallels
Raise the quill and run the spindle at max RPM
Assume the table is trammed because it looks level

questions.question: If the cutting sound gets harsh and the cutter loads up, a likely cause is:
answers: Feed is too fast for the material or cutter size
Spindle speed is too low for carbide

questions.question: When cleaning chips from a milling machine, the safest choice is to:
answers: Use a brush, rag, or chip hook with the spindle stopped
Blow them away with compressed air while the spindle runs
Pick them out by hand near the cutter
Wipe them with a cloth while the quill is down

questions.question: Which spindle taper is most commonly found on a Bridgeport milling machine?
To bore a hole perpendicular to the face of the workpiece, the machine table should be _____________ to the spindle.
Before machining on a vertical mill, the first setup check should be:
answers: Run the spindle at max RPM to warm up
Check table travel, gibs, and lock handles

questions.question: When milling thin stock, the best practice to prevent lifting is to:
answers: Use only one clamp at the center
Clamp the part with adequate support and low-profile stops

questions.question: For a light finishing pass in aluminum, the best choice is typically:
answers: A high-speed steel end mill with tight margins
A carbide end mill with high helix and polished flutes

questions.question: In face milling, the primary purpose of the shell mill is to:
answers: Create a flat surface perpendicular to the spindle

questions.question: The most important PPE when milling is:
answers: Safety glasses and no loose clothing near rotating cutters

questions.question: A tool length offset (G43) is used to:
answers: Shift the part XY coordinate system
Set the tool Z reference from a chosen location
Select the next tool in the carousel

questions.question: Before cutting metal, the best verification method is to:
answers: Dry run with feed rate override and single block
Run full auto with coolant on

questions.question: In sinker EDM, the primary purpose of the dielectric is to:
answers: Flush debris and insulate between sparks

questions.question: A common mold core material chosen for high wear resistance is:
In moldmaking, a control plan is used to:
When planning CAM toolpaths from a print, the first question is usually:
answers: What material is available and how features will be machined
What post processor has the coolest name
How big the tool library can be

questions.question: To machine an open pocket efficiently, the best first choice is:
For finishing a boss wall with climb milling, cutter travel should be:
answers: Always from left to right regardless of rotation

questions.question: When setting up CAM for a machining center, the most important setup match is:
Depth cuts are used primarily to:
answers: Control load per pass when removing material in Z

questions.question: Tabs during external contouring are used to:
answers: Keep the part from falling out of the vise

questions.question: Before CAM machining, CAD geometry should typically be:
answers: Closed, clean, and dimensionally consistent with the print
Skipped if you know the machine well

questions.question: The best reason to simulate toolpaths before running the machine is to:
answers: Check for collisions, gouges, and missed features
Prove the CAM program has no typos

questions.question: Clock springing in coil stock is best described as:
answers: Curl in the coil like a clock spring

questions.question: The primary purpose of lockout/tagout in a pressroom is to:
answers: Achieve zero energy before repairs or adjustments

questions.question: During shearing, the correct stage sequence is:
The difference between attribute and variable measurement is:
answers: Attribute uses a dial indicator; variable uses go/no-go gages
Attribute is pass/fail; variable records a numeric value
Variable is visual; attribute requires a microscope
Attribute measures temperature; variable measures pressure

questions.question: Top dead center in a press stroke refers to:
A wheel grade "A" is generally considered:
Truing a grinding wheel is done to:
Between centers grinding requires proper alignment to prevent:
If the workpiece becomes excessively warm, the first adjustment should be:
answers: Reduce wheel speed or depth of cut

questions.question: Before mounting a new grinding wheel, the required check is to:
answers: Inspect for cracks and perform the ring test
Run it at full speed immediately

questions.question: The main purpose of the quill on a drill press is to:
answers: Advance and retract the cutting tool

questions.question: The chisel edge of a twist drill is the:
answers: Web at the center of the point

questions.question: If the drill is cutting roughly and leaving a poor finish, a common cause is:
answers: Too high RPM or too much feed
Drill too long for the job

questions.question: To remove a jammed drill from the chuck, the safest action is to:
answers: Use a pipe wrench on the drill shank
Stop the machine and use the chuck key properly
Pull it out by hand while it is still spinning
Increase spindle speed to free it

questions.question: Before drilling, the best layout check is to:
answers: Mark the center, use a center punch, and check position against the print
Guess based on eye alignment only

questions.question: Good job planning primarily helps to:
answers: Reduce setup time and ensure features are made in the right order

questions.question: Selecting feature datums on a print is important because it:
answers: Establishes measurement reference and affects tolerance buildup
Only affects the drawing title block
Is only used for cosmetic alignment

questions.question: When laying out multiple holes on a bolt circle, the better practice is to:
answers: Measure each hole from an arbitrary edge
Use a dividing head or rotary table / calculated chord/stepover for repeatability
Rely on scribe lines alone without layout fluid
Drill one hole and assume the rest align

questions.question: Taper per foot is calculated from:
answers: Larger diameter minus smaller diameter over the length

questions.question: When hand filing a flat surface, cross-filing followed by draw-filing is intended to:
answers: Remove stock fast and then improve flatness/finish

questions.question: EDM removes material primarily by:
answers: Electrical sparks between electrode and workpiece

questions.question: A common electrode material for EDM is:
Increasing spark energy in EDM typically increases:
answers: Material removal rate and rougher surface finish

questions.question: Good flushing in EDM is important because it:
answers: Removes debris and stabilizes spark gaps

questions.question: A key safety consideration with EDM dielectric fluid is:
answers: It is nontoxic only when heated
Vapor inhalation, flammability, and slip hazards
It can be used indefinitely without filtering

questions.question: Typical EDM surface texture is characterized by:
answers: A crisscross or random ripple pattern called recast

questions.question: A common safety control near the point of operation on a press is:
Bend behavior in sheet metal is affected by:
answers: Grain direction, bend radius, and material thickness

questions.question: Lamination in sheet metal is best described as:
answers: A separation or delamination within the material

questions.question: A key preventative maintenance task before startup includes:
answers: Checking fluid levels, air pressure, and lubrication
Increasing stroke rate to warm up
Loading extra coil to save time
Skipping controls check if yesterday was good

questions.question: If a finished stamped part shows a consistent undersize flange, the first check should usually be:
answers: Tool wear, die clearances, and material thickness

questions.question: At Level III, a control plan is expected to define:
answers: Inspection criteria, frequency, and reaction rules

questions.question: For high-volume stamping control, the better quality approach is:
answers: Sampling plans with SPC and defined control limits
No inspection if the die is new

questions.question: When a progressive die breaks a pilot, the first action should usually be:
answers: Run faster to finish the shift
Stop production, inspect die/burrs, and check strip guidance
Ignore it if only one part is bad

questions.question: Documentation control in advanced stamping is important because it:
answers: Maintains traceability and consistent process actions

questions.question: A practical process-improvement action in stamping is to:
answers: Reduce scrap, standardize die changeover, and track key variables
Increase changeover time for cooler tools

questions.question: If chatter appears on a turned surface, the most useful first adjustment is often:
answers: Reduce RPM, check tool overhang, and tighten setup

questions.question: The primary purpose of the leadscrew on a lathe is to:
answers: Drive carriage movement for threading and power feeding

questions.question: For a Unified thread form, the infeed should usually be:
answers: Taper infeed or compound feed to avoid overload

questions.question: A clearance fit means the assembled parts have:
answers: Positive allowance for ease of assembly

questions.question: When laying out a turned part, a typical layout reference is:
answers: Centerline and end faces with a height gage or surface gauge

questions.question: A typical CAM-to-machine workflow usually ends with:
answers: Skipping setup because CAM was used
Post-processing, verification, and setup sheet review
Writing each line by hand on the machine

questions.question: A proper print-read habit before programming is to:
answers: Check tolerances, datum references, and revision block

questions.question: Tool length compensation is important because it:
answers: Sets each tool's length reference so Z depth is accurate

questions.question: Work offsets in mill CNC are used to:
answers: Establish part coordinate origins for different setups or fixtures

questions.question: A typical manual CNC milling routine only sequence check should confirm:
answers: Tool sequence, feeds, speeds, rapids vs cuts, and safety moves

questions.question: A fixture plate with repeatable locators primarily supports:
answers: Consistent part location across setups or batches

questions.question: A common finishing method for mold cavities is:
answers: Hand stoning, polishing, or EDM finish

questions.question: Mold cavity dimension verification often requires:
answers: Traceable measurement and sometimes CMM or probe inspection

questions.question: A proven pre-run verification sequence should include:
answers: Dry run, single block, offset confirmation, and stock check
Skipping offsets if the tool looks aligned
Full auto with coolant on the first try

questions.question: Choosing finish versus roughing toolpaths is primarily about:
answers: Removing material fast vs maintaining tolerances and finish

questions.question: Before production on a new pallet, the setup sheet supports:
First-article verification is used to:
answers: Confirm setup and program output before full production

questions.question: RepeatLoc is important in workholding because it:
answers: Maintains positional accuracy across multiple setups

questions.question: A moldmaking traveler or router typically ensures:
answers: Routing of the part through inspection stages and process steps

questions.question: Hand finishing after EDM in mold work is commonly required to:
answers: Remove recast layer and improve fit/finish

questions.question: A common reason to use hardened tool steel for mold cores is:
Validating mold parting surfaces often requires:
answers: Flatness/parallelism checks and sometimes light/seal tests
Only one check at room temperature

questions.question: A process plan for mold components should address:
answers: Operations sequence, stock removal, and gage/inspection steps
